input.subject: Action needed: documents for Al Ofoq Printing registration
input.body:
Dear Sara,

Thank you for your documents. To complete registration we need two items:

- GOSI certificate: the copy provided expired on 2026-05-10. Please send a current certificate.
- Zakat certificate: not received. Please send a valid copy.

Please reply to this email with the documents attached.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team
